candidatesAccepted.summary: A groomed-trail day ride around Lac-Saint-Jean offers a longer, flatter option for riders building confidence. The destination and access needs were not answered, so suitability for those is unknown and I have not assumed it.

candidatesAccepted.title: Groomed-trail day riding from Saguenay
candidatesAccepted.summary: A groomed-trail network close to Saguenay suits a mixed group where two riders are new, and it matches your preference for fewer kilometres on groomed trail over off-trail riding. I could not account for your destination, ages, access needs or rule-out conditions, so check those before committing. Trail status and grooming come from the local snowmobile club and the Fédération des clubs de motoneigistes du Québec, not from this suggestion.

candidatesAccepted.title: Monts-Valin groomed-trail riding
candidatesAccepted.summary: Monts-Valin offers groomed riding in a managed park, which suits the less experienced riders and your groomed-only preference. I did not check access rules, current grooming or whether rental machines are permitted there. Confirm with the park operator before relying on this.

candidatesAccepted.title: Lac-Saint-Jean groomed-trail network
candidatesAccepted.summary: The Lac-Saint-Jean side has an extensive groomed network that could support a longer day for the experienced riders while staying on trail. I did not confirm the season, rental terms or whether the route fits your 180 km range between stops. Check current trail conditions with the local snowmobile club and the regional tourism authority.

candidatesAccepted.title: Rental snowmobiles with a groomed-trail pass from Saguenay
candidatesAccepted.summary: Renting machines locally keeps the paperwork in one place: confirm the rental agreement, the insurance it includes, and whether a Quebec snowmobile trail pass is needed for the groomed network. I do not know the destination, the ages, access needs, or the riders' limits, so none of those are accounted for here, and the rental terms and trail-pass rules need checking with the operator before anything is relied on.

candidatesAccepted.title: Rental with an instructed first-day session for novice riders
candidatesAccepted.summary: Two of the four have never ridden, so a rental that includes a short instructed session on groomed trail before longer runs is worth asking about. I could not confirm what the operator offers, whether they accept the group's ages or access needs, or whether the riders' limits allow it, so this is a proposal to check rather than a confirmed fit.

gaps.detail: This part of the plan was left out to keep the run inside its budget. Re-planning with a larger budget would fill it in.
